pr_metadata.title: Add char limit warn
pr_metadata.description:
- [x] Add language dependent char limits
- [x] Fix error on failed audio loading during training

gold_comments.issue_summary:
Use a set for more performance?
```suggestion
        if lang in {"en", "es", "fr", "de", "pt", "it", "pl", "ar", "cs", "ru", "nl", "tr", "zh-cn"}:
```
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The code uses a list literal `[...]` in an `in` check where a set `{...}` would be more performant.
gold_comments.rationale: Using a list for membership testing in a tight loop or frequently-called function is less efficient than using a set, as set lookups are O(1) average-case.
